about: scripts/surface: the language surface counted from the parser and the spec, kept in docs/spec/README.md (SURFACE-COUNT, LANG-HEALTH 4.3; PROBATION q228). The use counts and the spec's word count are informational, not checked.

mutants.name: surface-new-word
mutants.origin: wf10 SURFACE-COUNT (LANG-HEALTH 4.3: a new contextual word added to the parser with no README row)
mutants.from: func atWhere(p mut parser) bool { isWord(p, "where") }
mutants.to: func atWhere(p mut parser) bool { isWord(p, "where") || isWord(p, "whereas") }
mutants.rule: A word the parser reads by its spelling is a form with a README row.

mutants.name: surface-new-production
mutants.rule: A production and a signature clause the grammar adds change the README's count.

mutants.name: surface-probation-one-count
mutants.origin: wf10 SURFACE-COUNT (PROBATION q228: under 10 uses at two counts in a row)
mutants.rule: A form goes to the owner only after two low counts in a row.
